Hero.Title: Governance and succession
Hero.Description: Clear family governance, a prepared transition. We support family charters, next-generation education and the coordination of succession planning under Swiss law.

Intro: The durability of a family's wealth rests as much on its governance as on its performance. Shared rules, understood and respected, are worth more than decisions taken under pressure.
We help your family set a lasting framework and prepare the transition, in coordination with your lawyers and notaries, and in line with Swiss civil law.

Pillars.Title: Governance charters
Pillars.Body: Drafting and maintaining family charters that define principles, roles and decision-making.

Pillars.Title: Next generation
Pillars.Body: Supporting and educating the next generation, for a gradual handover of responsibilities.

Pillars.Title: Succession coordination
Pillars.Body: Coordinating succession planning with your lawyers and notaries, within the framework of Swiss civil law.

Pillars.Title: Family councils
Pillars.Body: Preparing and facilitating family councils, for structured and documented discussions.

Closing.Title: A composed transition
Closing.Body: A clear framework reduces tension and protects family unity. We coordinate it, discreetly and over the long term.

Perimeter: Execution, custody and asset management remain with your chosen regulated banks and asset managers. Ridger provides consolidation, reporting, coordination and administrative oversight. Ridger does not manage assets and does not provide investment advice.
